div.span:
RLinf RL Training (Single-Node)
- VLA policy (7B), FSDP across the node GPUs
- GPU-accelerated simulator (ManiSkill3 or LIBERO)
- All RL components colocated in one K8s Job
- ManiSkill / pi0 (default): gpu-sim pool, 2 GPUs
- Wan GRPO: gpu-training pool (p5en), 8 GPUs
- Checkpoint + model weights on FSx for Lustre
